q: In the fraud-2026 project, what is fraud26-gbm-v3?
a: The current card-not-present fraud model (2026-08-19): LightGBM on velocity-v2, device-age, MCC-risk, geo-mismatch and amount z-score features, trained with a 60-day label maturity cut. It reaches AUC 0.933 and KS 0.72 on fraud26-oot-2026h1 (exp-207), with alert threshold 0.66.

q: What came of the velocity-v2 leak check in fraud-2026 (fraud26-find-velocity-leak)?
a: exp-203 and exp-204 gave AUC 0.94 with post-period days and 0.88 without, first read as target leakage. On 2026-05-20 exp-205 traced it to a join-window bug and showed a clean velocity-v2 at AUC 0.921, so fraud26-find-velocity-clean overturned the leak finding.

q: What does fraud26-gbm-v2 depend on in fraud-2026?
a: fraud26-gbm-v2 uses feat-f26-velocity-v2, feat-f26-device-age and feat-f26-mcc-risk, trained on ds-f26-labels-2026 and ds-f26-cnp-txn with only labels at least 60 days old (dec-f26-maturity-60d).

q: What alert threshold does the fraud-2026 model use now?
a: 0.66 on fraud26-gbm-v3 (dec-f26-promote-v3, 2026-08-26). It superseded the 0.62 cut-off set with fraud26-gbm-v2 in dec-f26-promote-v2, and there is no travel-specific uplift.

q: What AUC and KS did fraud26-gbm-v3 reach on fraud26-oot-2026h1?
a: AUC 0.933 and KS 0.72 on fraud26-oot-2026h1 (1,842,300 transactions, 4,213 matured fraud labels as of 2026-06-01), evaluated 2026-07-02 in exp-207.

q: Why does fraud-2026 train only on labels at least 60 days old?
a: dec-f26-maturity-60d (2026-03-10): chargeback labels arrive up to 60 days late, and treating immature frauds as legit cut AUC from 0.912 to 0.889 on fraud26-oot-2025q4 (exp-201 vs exp-202), so younger labels are dropped.
